name: LEGO GEAR SOLID - Cargo Dock
author: PeraStation
description:
My first Unity microgame, clearly inspired by the popular stealth action game we all know and love.
I was just having a little fun with this project, it's missing a lot of features, plus there are many bugs that I couldn't bother fixing.

Everything was created with LEGO Microgame (template/foundation),
LEGO Behaviour Bricks (logic) 
and BrickLink Studio (LEGO modeling). 
The underwater effect was created with SineWave Effect by Justin Garza (available on the Asset Store).

- Enjoy!
